translations.web: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
translations.bsb: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
translations.kjv: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God.
